New IAF Chief Ashutosh Dixit Unveils 'VAYU' Vision for Air Force

Air Chief Marshal Ashutosh Dixit assumed command of the Indian Air Force (IAF) on Saturday, succeeding Air Chief Marshal Amar Preet Singh after 42 years of service. In his first address, Dixit unveiled his vision for the force, named 'VAYU', which emphasizes readiness, self-reliance, and jointness. The vision aims to prepare the IAF for future combat scenarios.
